prompt: a long dinner table as a tabletop diorama, seen from above at an angle: twelve guests on spindle-back chairs, plates, glasses, candles, gourds and leaves down the runner and the big roast in the middle; the dishes come out of the kitchen at the end of the table, steaming, and each guest thinks of the dish they want; pass the dish you hold along the table seat to seat before it goes cold: hot is a cheer and points, cold is a grumble; four courses, each quicker, and from the third the table passes both ways; when the last dish is down, dinner is served and everyone raises a glass
title: Table for Twelve
author: pip
